verdict.rationale: The official Intuit MCP server exposes full CRUD across 29 entity types (likely including journal entries) and a QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE flag to gate write actions, so an agent can draft/post entries via API, and QuickBooks separately offers accountant access to the books. However there is no evidence of a purpose-built 'review queue' or draft/pending-approval workflow for journal entries awaiting accountant sign-off—accountants would just see posted transactions, not a staged queue. Missing for 10: a documented pending/draft-approval state for journal entries, a review-queue UI or API concept, and evidence the MCP write-restriction feature ties into an approval workflow rather than simply blocking writes entirely.
